item.title: Copper Price Surge on Global Supply Squeeze and Tariff Speculation a Tailwind for Australian Miners
item.description: Copper has been on a strong upward trajectory in recent weeks, climbing more than 30% on the London Metal Exchange this year as traders and analysts warn that global inventories could soon hit critically low levels.

item.title: Red Mountain Mining Identifies New Antimony Veins in Sampling at Armidale’s Oaky Creek Prospect
item.description: Red Mountain Mining (ASX: RMX) has identified new antimony veins in an expanded exploration program at the Oaky Creek prospect within its Armidale antimony-gold project in New South Wales.

item.title: Broken Hill Mines Prepares to Ramp-Up Production at Rasp’s Blackwoods Silver-Lead-Zinc Ore Body
item.description: Broken Hill Mines (ASX: BHM) is preparing to ramp-up mining and processing activities at the high-grade Main Lode within the Blackwoods underground silver-lead-zinc ore body at its Rasp silver mine in NSW.

item.title: Prospect Resources Identifies New High-Grade Copper Zone at Mumbezhi Project in Zambia
item.description: Prospect Resources (ASX: PSC) has defined a new high-grade copper zone at the Nyungu Central deposit within its 85%-owned Mumbezhi copper project in north-west Zambia.

item.title: Cavalier Resources Hits High-Grade Gold in Crawford Extensional Drilling Program
item.description: Cavalier Resources (ASX: CVR) has identified the potential to significantly expand its Crawford gold project in Western Australia with promising early results from extensional drilling.

item.title: West Coast Silver and Artemis Resources to Explore Processing of Elizabeth Hill Ore at Radio Hill Concentrator
item.description: West Coast Silver (ASX: WCE) will collaborate with Artemis Resources (ASX: ARV) to determine whether ore from West Coast’s Elizabeth Hill silver mine could be economically processed at Artemis’ Radio Hill concentrator, 25 km to the north in WA’s Pilbara region.

item.title: Argenica Study Confirms Compatibility of ARG-007 Candidate with Stroke Treatment Standard-of-Care Therapies
item.description: Argenica Therapeutics (ASX: AGN) has reported positive results from a drug-to-drug interaction assessment showing its lead candidate ARG-007 does not interfere with clot-dissolving agent tenecteplase in the treatment of acute ischemic stroke.

item.title: Ballymore Resources Confirms Exceptional Polymetallic Grades at Torpy’s Prospect
item.description: Ballymore Resources (ASX: BMR) has reported exceptional high-grade silver, lead, zinc, and indium mineralisation from the first reverse circulation drilling at the Torpy’s prospect within its Ruddygore Project in North Queensland.

item.title: St George Mining Working Hard in Brazil to Earn Local Support for Araxá Project
item.description: St George Mining (ASX: SGQ) continues to receive strong local backing for its proposed development of the Araxá project in Brazil, with more than 200 stakeholders attending an open day and critical minerals forum the company recently hosted in Minas Gerais.

item.title: OMG Group Reports Record Online and In-Store Sales for November Across Multi-Brand Portfolio
item.description: Health-focused food products company OMG Group (ASX: OMG) has reported record sales for November from its multi-brand portfolio across physical store distribution networks and e-commerce channels.
